title: Common definitions shared by all chatbot-contracts schemas

contractVersion.description: chatbot-contracts schemaVersion, semver-like (major.minor.patch). A breaking change bumps major.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest, exactly 64 characters.

opaqueCapabilityToken.description: Short-lived, run-scoped capability token. Opaque to the schema; never logged, never rendered to a client.

utcTimestamp.description: Server-generated UTC timestamp, RFC 3339 with a literal Z offset.

ianaTimezone.description: IANA time zone database name (e.g. Asia/Taipei, UTC).

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag, e.g. en, en-US, zh-TW.

trustedOrigin.description: Server-controlled message/actor origin. Only USER_UI may ever appear as a *trigger* origin (see ingress-request.schema.json) — this enum exists for completion/context/audit payloads that legitimately reference other origins after the fact.

deploymentRevisionSnapshot.description: Immutable snapshot of the Deployment identity a Run was pinned to at dispatch time.
